question: The lens which is thin in the middle and thick at its periphery is called a:
solution:
The correct answer is a __**concave lens.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** concave lens** is a type of lens that is thin in the middle but thick at its periphery. 
 
• A concave lens is also called diverging lens meaning that it spreads out light rays that have been refracted through it.
 
• A concave lens is used to correct short-sightedness (myopia) and is also used in binoculars, telescopes, cameras, flashlights. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Convex lens-** 

 
 
• It is thick in the middle and thin at its periphery.
 
• It is also called converging lens meaning that it will focus all the rays of lights (coming from infinity) at its focus. 
 
• A convex lens is used to correct farsightedness. It is also used as a simple reading lens.
